rows.statement: Live team bands played at NFL home games in the 1970s and 1980s (Redskins at RFK Stadium in 1983, Chiefs at Arrowhead from 1972 to 1988, Packers house band under Lovell Ives from 1982, Colts band to 1983).

sources.locator: archive page text; quote as relayed by the fetch agent
sources.quote: piccolo player who tweedles 'Hail to the Redskins' from the wind-chilled bandstand at RFK Stadium.

sources.locator: article text; quote as relayed by the fetch agent
sources.quote: When the Chiefs moved to Arrowhead Stadium in 1972, DiPardo and his band moved with them.

sources.locator: article text; quote as relayed by the fetch agent
sources.quote: Ives was director of the team's house band from 1982-97.

rows.notes: Four independent pages, three of them later retrospectives; only the Washington Post item is a contemporary dated account. Quotes were relayed by a fetch agent and not saved locally, so re-read each page before relying on the exact wording. The Ravens page gives a span with no game detail. Stadium ORGAN use in the NFL in 1970-1989 has no dated source yet (the Stadium organist and Music at sporting events pages name no NFL team or year), so the organ stays off in the presentation until one is found.
